blocks.text: Every October, Life Insurance Consciousness Month reminds Filipinos of the importance of protecting themselves and their families from life’s uncertainties. However, awareness is only the first step. The more meaningful question is whether that awareness leads to action. That question is especially relevant today. Rising living costs are forcing many families to focus on immediate expenses, often at the expense of longer-term security. Sun Life’s Financial Resilience Index 2026 found that the proportion of highly resilient Filipino households fell from 33% to 19%.
